snippet.title: Feline Fever Dream – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Feline Fever Dream is a story-driven RPG where you experience the world through the eyes of a cat. Unravel the mystery of your forgotten past while embracing the everyday life of a feline—hunt, explore, make friends, and roam an island full of unique cat communities. Every choice you make will shape your story.
